meta.author: Spaceballs
meta.description: Released in December 1992 by the Norwegian demogroup Spaceballs, State of the Art is an Amiga 500 demo that won first place at The Party II. The production placed a strong emphasis on visual design and animation rather than focusing primarily on technical demonstrations of hardware effects. It combines a synchronized electronic soundtrack with rotoscoped animations of dancing silhouettes. The entire demo fits on a single floppy disk and runs on a standard Amiga 500 with 1 MB of RAM.
